summary_1line: During the rigged dice game, Yudhishthira repeatedly stakes vast wealth—servants, animals, chariots, troops, and jewels—and loses each throw to Sakuni’s deceit.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sakuni casts the dice with a sly smile while Yudhishthira, tense and pale, watches as courtiers sit in anxious silence.
A vision of Yudhishthira’s immense wealth—elephants with golden girdles, chariots with tall banners, and rows of ornamented servants—being wagered away in the royal hall.
Sakuni laughing lightly as he declares 'I have won!' while Yudhishthira sits rigid on the gambling floor surrounded by stunned elders.
